_review: Draft English translations of platform content stored in the database (exercise instructions, condition and session names/descriptions, body areas), written by Claude on 2026-11-07. Key = exact French text in the database. Must be reviewed by the partner physio before launch. Generated from a database export; to add an entry, copy the French text exactly.
À genoux à côté d'une chaise stable, mai: Kneel beside a stable chair, hands on the seat. Bring one foot forward into a half-kneeling position, then push through your front leg and the chair to stand up.
À genoux, chevilles maintenues fixes, la: Kneel with your ankles held in place, let your upper body lean slowly forwards while resisting with the back of your thighs for as long as possible, then catch yourself with your hands.
À genoux, roue tenue à deux mains devant: Kneeling, with the wheel held in both hands in front of you, roll it forwards keeping your back straight and your abdominals braced, as far as you can control, then roll it back to the starting position.
À quatre pattes, alternez entre creuser: On all fours, alternate between hollowing your back while lifting your head (cow position) and rounding your back while tucking your chin in (cat position), in time with your breathing.
À quatre pattes, dos plat, tendez simult: On all fours with your back flat, stretch one arm out in front of you and the opposite leg out behind you at the same time, without rotating your pelvis, then return and alternate.
À quatre pattes, dos plat. Genou plié, d: On all fours, back flat. With your knee bent, lift one leg and slowly draw circles with your knee, without moving your back or pelvis, in one direction and then the other.
À quatre pattes, gardez les omoplates st: On all fours, keep your shoulder blades stable while lifting one arm slightly, then the other.
À quatre pattes, genou fléchi à angle dr: On all fours, knee bent at a right angle, lift your leg out to the side like a dog's leg, without rotating your pelvis, then lower it with control.
On all fours, with your knee bent at a right angle, push your heel up towards the ceiling keeping the knee angle the same, without arching your back, then lower with control.
À quatre pattes, genoux légèrement décol: On all fours with your knees slightly off the floor, move forwards by moving one hand and the opposite foot at the same time, with your back flat and your pelvis stable.
À quatre pattes. Ouvrez un bras vers le: On all fours. Open one arm towards the ceiling, rotating your upper body, then thread that arm under your chest to the other side until your shoulder rests on the floor. Return slowly.
Activation douce des fessiers et mobilit: Gentle glute activation and hip mobility.
Allongé sous une barre fixe, corps droit: Lie under a fixed bar, body straight and braced, pull your chest towards the bar while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Allongé sur le côté, appui sur l'avant-b: Lie on your side, resting on your forearm, lift your pelvis slightly and hold for a few seconds.
Allongé sur le côté, genoux fléchis et p: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your feet together, one on top of the other. Open your top knee like a clamshell without letting your pelvis roll backwards, then close it with control.
Allongé sur le côté, jambe du dessous lé: Lying on your side with your bottom leg slightly bent, lift your straight top leg towards the ceiling without letting your pelvis roll backwards, then lower it with control.
Allongé sur le côté, la jambe du dessus: Lying on your side, with your top leg bent and your foot placed in front of your bottom knee. Lift your straight bottom leg a few centimetres, then lower it slowly.
Allongé sur le côté, le bras du dessous: Lying on your side with your bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent at 90°. Using your other hand, gently push your forearm down towards the floor in front of you, without forcing. Hold the position.
Allongé sur le côté, une serviette roulé: Lying on your side, with a rolled-up towel under your top elbow, elbow bent at 90° and tucked against your body, holding a light dumbbell. Rotate your forearm towards the ceiling without lifting your elbow away, then lower it slowly.
Allongé sur le dos, appuyé sur les avant: Lying on your back, propped up on your forearms, your other leg stretched out on the floor. Tighten your thigh to lock your knee, then lift your straight leg to about 45°, without bending your knee. Lower it slowly.
Allongé sur le dos, barre ou haltères au: Lying on your back with the bar or dumbbells at chest level, push the weight up until your arms are straight, then slowly lower it under control until it lightly touches your chest.
Allongé sur le dos, bras et jambes tendu: Lying on your back, arms and legs straight, lift your upper body and straight legs at the same time to touch your feet with your hands, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, bras tendus derrière: Lie on your back, arms stretched out behind your head, legs straight and slightly lifted, lower back pressed into the floor, and hold this banana-shaped position.
Lie on your back, arms stretched out behind your head, legs straight, lower back pressed into the floor, and rock your body gently back and forth while keeping the hollow position.
Allongé sur le dos, bras tendus vers le: Lie on your back with your arms straight up towards the ceiling and your knees bent with your shins vertical. Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg towards the floor without lifting your lower back, then return and alternate.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis pieds: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the floor. Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes until your hips, knees and shoulders are in line, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis vers: Lie on your back, knees bent towards your chest, lift your pelvis off the floor by curling your lower back, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis, bass: Lie on your back, knees bent, pelvis lifted into a bridge. Bring one knee towards your chest without letting your pelvis drop, put the foot back down, then alternate.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis, main: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Lift your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abdominals, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis, pied: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor. Tilt your pelvis backwards, flattening your lower back against the floor while gently tightening your stomach, without lifting your buttocks. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis, un b: Lying on your back, knees bent, holding a stick in both hands, shoulder-width apart, elbows straight. Slowly raise the stick above your chest and then above your head as far as you can without severe pain, your good arm helping the other. Lower it slowly.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis, une: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one hand on your chest and the other on your stomach. Breathe in slowly through your nose, letting your stomach rise while the hand on your chest stays still, then breathe out gently.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux fléchis. Rame: Lie on your back, knees bent. Bring one knee towards your chest with both hands under the knee, then both knees together, holding your shins. Hold the position while breathing calmly.
Allongé sur le dos, genoux pliés, laisse: Lie on your back, knees bent, let your knees drop to one side and then the other, shoulders on the floor.
Allongé sur le dos, jambe tendue vers le: Lie on your back, leg straight towards the ceiling, supported by your hands or a strap, without pain.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes fléchies à la: Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted with shins vertical, alternately touch one heel to the floor on each side without lifting your lower back, then return to the centre.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes tendues et po: Lie on your back, legs straight and resting on the floor. Without moving your leg, tighten your thigh muscle hard, pressing the back of your knee down into the floor and pulling your toes towards you. Hold the contraction for a few seconds, then relax.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes tendues légèr: Lie on your back, legs straight and slightly lifted off the floor, and kick your legs alternately in a small range of movement, lower back pressed into the floor.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes tendues vers: Lying on your back, legs stretched up towards the ceiling, lift your upper body, reaching your arms towards your feet, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes tendues, leve: Lie on your back, legs straight, lift them until they are vertical while keeping your lower back on the floor, then lower them slowly without fully resting them down.
Allongé sur le dos, jambes tendues. Fait: Lie on your back, legs straight. Slowly slide your heel along the floor towards your buttocks, bending your knee as far as you can without strong pain, then slide your heel back to straighten your leg again.
Allongé sur le dos, la tête posée. Faite: Lying on your back, head resting. Make a small "yes" nod with your head by gently tucking your chin towards your throat, the back of your head staying on the floor. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.
Allongé sur le dos, mains derrière la tê: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and bring each elbow in turn towards the opposite knee while pedalling with your legs, without pulling on your neck.
Allongé sur le dos, plantes de pieds joi: Lie on your back, soles of your feet together, knees falling outwards, lift your pelvis by squeezing your glutes, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le dos, talons posés au sol,: Lie on your back, heels on the floor, pelvis lifted, slowly walk your heels outwards while keeping your pelvis high, then bring them back.
Allongé sur le dos, talons posés sur une: Lying on your back with your heels on a towel or a ball and your pelvis lifted, bend your knees to bring your heels towards your buttocks, then straighten your legs again with control.
Allongé sur le dos, un genou fléchi pied: Lying on your back, one knee bent with the foot on the floor and the other leg straight, lift your pelvis by pushing through the foot on the floor until your hips are in line with your shoulders, then lower.
Allongé sur le ventre au sol, le front p: Lie on your front on the floor, forehead resting on a rolled towel, arms straight out to the sides in a T, thumbs pointing up. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift both arms a few centimetres, without lifting your head. Hold for one second, then lower them slowly.
Allongé sur le ventre sur un banc inclin: Lie on your front on an incline bench, arms straight forming a T, raise your arms slightly towards the ceiling while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Lie on your front on an incline bench, arms straight forming a Y, raise your arms slightly towards the ceiling while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le ventre, bras le long du c: Lie on your front, arms by your sides, lift your upper body slightly and sweep your arms forwards in an arc as if making a snow angel, then return.
Allongé sur le ventre, bras tendus devan: Lying on your front, arms stretched out in front of you, lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time and hold the position for a few seconds.
Lying on your front, arms stretched out in front of you, lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time, then lower with control.
Allongé sur le ventre, chevilles sous le: Lie on your front, ankles under the machine's rollers, bend your knees to bring your heels towards your buttocks, then lower slowly.
Allongé sur le ventre, front posé sur le: Lie on your front, forehead resting on your hands. Squeeze your glutes and lift one straight leg a few centimetres, without arching your lower back, then lower slowly.
Allongé sur le ventre, les mains derrièr: Lie on your front, hands behind your head, elbows out to the sides. Slowly lift your upper body off the floor, keeping your eyes on the floor and your legs down, then lower with control. Stop before any pain in your lower back.
Allongé sur le ventre, mains sous les ép: Lie on your front, hands under your shoulders. First come up onto your forearms, then straighten your arms to lift your upper body, keeping your pelvis and thighs on the floor and your buttocks relaxed. Lower slowly.
Allongé sur le ventre. Pliez un genou et: Lie on your front. Bend one knee and take hold of your ankle with the hand on the same side, then gently bring your heel towards your buttock, without arching your lower back. Hold the position.
Allongé sur un banc incliné, un haltère: Lie on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand at upper-chest level, push them upwards until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.
Assis au bord d'une chaise, dos droit. T: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight. Straighten your knee while pulling your toes towards you and lifting your head, then bend your knee while lowering your head. Alternate slowly, without forcing.
Assis au bord d'une chaise, les pieds à: Sit on the edge of a chair, feet flat, back straight. Tuck your chin in, then slowly curl your back forward, one vertebra at a time, letting your arms drop towards the floor. Then come back up just as slowly, uncurling your back until you are sitting up straight.
Assis au bord d'une chaise, pieds à plat: Sitting on the edge of a chair, feet flat and slightly behind your knees, arms crossed over your chest. Lean your upper body forward and stand up without using your hands until you are standing up straight in front of the chair, then sit back down slowly.
Sitting on the edge of a chair, feet flat. Lean your upper body forward, stand up and push hard through your legs to jump upwards, then land softly in front of the chair with your knees bent.
Assis au sol, jambes tendues, élastique: Sit on the floor with your legs straight, a resistance band looped under the front of your foot and held in both hands. Push your toes forwards against the band, as if pressing a pedal, then slowly return.

Sit on the floor with your legs straight, a resistance band looped over the top of your foot and anchored in front of you. Pull your toes towards you against the band as far as you can, then slowly return.
Assis au sol, le talon de la jambe à tra: Sit on the floor with the heel of the leg you are working resting on a rolled towel, so the knee is unsupported. Let your knee sink towards the floor by relaxing your thigh, then press gently with your hands just above the knee to gain more extension. Hold the position.
Assis au sol, un genou plié. Posez le co: Sit on the floor with one knee bent. Rest your elbow on your knee, straight in front of your shoulder, elbow bent at 90°, holding a small dumbbell (or a water bottle), forearm horizontal. Without moving your elbow, rotate your forearm upwards until it is vertical, then lower it slowly.
Assis bien droit, épaules basses. Penche: Sit up straight, shoulders relaxed down. Slowly tilt your head to bring your ear towards your shoulder, without lifting the shoulder, return to the centre, then tilt to the other side.
Assis bien droit, regard à l'horizontale: Sit up straight, looking straight ahead. Tuck your chin in by drawing your head straight back, as if making a double chin, without tipping your head down. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.
Assis bien droit, tête immobile. Poussez: Sit up straight with your head still. Gently push your head against your hand without letting it move: hand on your forehead, then on the side of your head, then both hands behind your head. Hold for a few seconds in each direction, without forcing.
Assis bien droit, une main posée à plat: Sit up straight with one hand flat on the opposite collarbone. Tilt your head to the opposite side and slightly back until you feel the stretch along the side of your neck. Hold the position.
Assis bien droit. Baissez lentement la t: Sit up straight. Slowly lower your head to bring your chin towards your chest, then gently lift it to look upwards, without forcing.
Assis bien droit. Rentrez d'abord le men: Sit up straight. First tuck your chin in by drawing your head back (double chin), then, from that position, gently tilt your head back to look at the ceiling. Slowly return.
Assis bien droit. Tournez lentement la t: Sit up straight. Slowly turn your head to one side as far as you can without pain, keeping your shoulders still, return to the centre, then turn to the other side.
Assis face à la poulie basse, jambes lég: Sitting facing the low pulley with your legs slightly bent, pull the handle towards your stomach, keeping your back straight and squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.
Assis face à la poulie haute, tirez la b: Sitting facing the high pulley, pull the bar down to your upper chest while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then let it rise with control until your arms are straight.
Assis ou allongé face à la machine, poig: Sitting or lying facing the machine, handles at chest level, push forwards until your arms are straight, then return slowly.
Assis ou debout, jambe tendue devant vou: Sitting or standing, with your leg straight in front of you, lean your upper body forwards, keeping your back straight, until you feel the stretch at the back of your thigh, and hold the position.
Assis ou debout, pied nu à plat. Sans re: Sitting or standing, barefoot with your foot flat. Without curling your toes, draw the front of your foot towards your heel to lift the arch of your foot. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.
Assis sous une poulie fixée en hauteur (: Sitting under a pulley fixed up high (on a door), with a handle in each hand. Pull down with your good arm to gently raise your operated arm above your head, then lower it slowly.
Assis sur les talons, penchez le buste v: Sitting back on your heels, lean your upper body forwards with your arms stretched out in front of you on the floor and your forehead resting on the floor, and hold the position while breathing calmly.
Assis sur une chaise à dossier, mains de: Sitting on a chair with a backrest, hands behind your head. Lean your upper back backwards over the backrest, elbows towards the ceiling, without arching your lower back. Return slowly.
Assis sur une chaise, genoux à 90°. Sans: Sitting on a chair with your knees at 90°. Without moving your thigh, rotate your lower leg to bring your foot inwards and then outwards, slowly.
Assis sur une chaise, pied à plat. Faite: Sitting on a chair with your foot flat. Slide your foot back under the chair to bend your knee as far as you can without severe pain, hold for a moment, then return.
Assis sur une chaise, pieds au sol, un p: Sit on a chair with your feet on the floor and a small ball (or a cushion) between your knees. Squeeze the ball by bringing your knees together, hold for a few seconds, then gently release.
Assis sur une chaise, posez la cheville: Sitting on a chair, place your ankle on the opposite knee. Keeping your back straight, lean your upper body forward until you feel the stretch in your buttock. Hold the position.
Assis sur une chaise, talon au sol, élas: Sit on a chair with your heel on the floor, a resistance band looped around the front of your foot and anchored on the outer side. Turn the sole of your foot inwards against the band, without moving your knee, then slowly return.

Sit on a chair with your heel on the floor, a resistance band looped around the front of your foot and anchored on the inner side. Turn the sole of your foot outwards against the band, without moving your knee, then slowly return.
Assis, buste légèrement penché en arrièr: Sitting, upper body leaning slightly back, hands on the floor behind you, alternate between drawing your knees towards your chest and straightening your legs, without putting your feet down.
Sitting, upper body leaning slightly back, feet lifted or resting on the floor, rotate your upper body from one side to the other, bringing your hands close to the floor on each side.
Assis, charge au niveau des épaules, pou: Sitting, with the weight at shoulder level, push it up until your arms are fully straight above your head, then slowly lower it back to shoulder level.
Assis, coude calé contre l'intérieur de: Sitting, with your elbow braced against the inside of your thigh, bend your elbow to lift the dumbbell towards your shoulder, then slowly lower.
Assis, détendu. Inspirez par le nez sur: Sit relaxed. Breathe in through your nose for a count of two, then breathe out slowly through your mouth, lips pursed as if blowing out a candle, for a count of four.
Assis, dos calé contre le dossier, pieds: Sit with your back firmly against the backrest, feet on the platform hip-width apart, bend your knees to bring the platform towards you, then push it away without fully locking your knees.
Assis, élastique positionné juste au-des: Sitting, with a resistance band just above your knees, push your knees apart against the resistance, then return with control.
Assis, haltères devant les épaules paume: Sitting, with the dumbbells in front of your shoulders and your palms facing you, push them upwards while turning your palms to face forwards until your arms are straight, then reverse the movement on the way down.
Assis, jambes tendues devant vous, pench: Sitting with your legs straight out in front of you, lean your upper body forward, keeping your back straight, until you feel the stretch at the back of your thighs, and hold the position.
Assis, l'arrière des chevilles contre le: Sitting with the backs of your ankles against the machine's rollers, bend your knees to bring your ankles towards the back of the seat, then return slowly.
Assis, l'avant-bras posé sur une table,: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, your hand over the edge holding a light dumbbell by the middle. Slowly turn your palm up and then down, without moving your elbow.
Assis, la cheville posée sur le genou op: Sitting with your ankle resting on the opposite knee. Using your hand, gently pull your toes towards your shin until you feel the stretch under the sole of your foot. Hold the position, breathing calmly.
Assis, la jambe allongée, le talon posé: Sit with your leg straight out, your heel resting on a small support and your foot hanging free. Slowly draw large circles with your toes, without moving your leg, in one direction and then the other.
Assis, la jambe tendue et la cuisse comp: Sit with your leg straight and your thigh completely relaxed. With your thumbs, gently slide your kneecap up and then down, then to the right and to the left, without pain.
Assis, mains au sol derrière vous, bassi: Sitting with your hands on the floor behind you and your hips lifted off the floor, move forwards by moving one hand and the opposite foot at the same time.
Assis, pied nu à plat sur une serviette: Sitting, barefoot with your foot flat on a towel laid on the floor. Keeping your heel on the floor, curl your toes to grab the towel and draw it towards you, then relax and start again.
Assis, pied nu, quelques petits objets (: Sitting, barefoot, with a few small objects (marbles, bottle caps) on the floor. Pick up an object with your toes, lift it and put it down a little further away, then start again.
Assis, plantes de pieds jointes, genoux: Sitting with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling outwards, lean your upper body slightly forwards until you feel the stretch along your inner thighs, and hold the position.
Assis, tibias contre les rouleaux de la: Sit with your shins against the machine's rollers, straighten your legs until they are horizontal, then lower slowly without releasing the tension.
Assis, une main tenant le bord de la cha: Sitting, one hand holding the edge of the chair. Tilt your head to the opposite side and place your other hand on your head to gently increase the stretch. Hold the position.

Sit with one hand holding the edge of the chair. Turn your head 45° to the other side and lower it as if looking at your armpit, with your other hand resting on your head to help gently. Hold the position.
Avant-bras posé sur une surface, paume v: Forearm resting on a surface, palm facing down, let your wrist drop down, then lift it back up by extending your wrist upwards, without moving your forearm.
Forearm resting on a surface, palm facing up, let your wrist drop down, then lift it back up by bending your wrist upwards, without moving your forearm.
Avant-bras posé, main hors du bord, pous: With your forearm supported and your hand over the edge, push the back of your hand upwards against resistance from your other hand, and hold.
Avant-bras posé, main hors du bord, remo: With your forearm resting and your hand over the edge, lift your wrist using your other hand, then let it lower slowly on its own.
Avant-bras posé, paume vers le haut, rem: With your forearm resting and your palm facing up, lift your wrist using your other hand, then let it lower slowly on its own.
Barre sur le haut du dos, pieds largeur: With the bar across your upper back and feet shoulder-width apart, lower yourself by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, back straight, then come back up by pushing through your feet.
Bassin calé sur le banc à hyperextension: With your hips supported on the hyperextension bench and your upper body leaning forwards, lift your upper body up to horizontal by squeezing your lower back and glutes, then lower with control.
Bras légèrement fléchis, ramenez les mai: With your arms slightly bent, bring your hands or the handles towards each other in front of your chest in a wide arc, then slowly return, letting your arms open out.
Bras tendus au-dessus de la tête, fléchi: With your arms straight above your head, bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten your arms again until fully extended.
Buste penché en avant (ou assis face à l: With your upper body leaning forwards (or sitting facing the machine), arms slightly bent, open your arms out to the sides while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.
Buste penché en avant en appui sur un su: With your upper body leaning forwards, supported on something, and the balls of your feet on a raised surface, rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then slowly lower, stretching your calves.
Buste penché en avant, bras à l'horizont: Upper body leaning forward, upper arm horizontal with the elbow bent, straighten your forearm backwards until your arm is fully extended, then return slowly.
Buste penché en avant, dos droit, un hal: With your upper body leaning forwards, your back straight and a dumbbell in each hand, pull your elbows back while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Courez à une allure régulière et confort: Run at a steady, comfortable pace with a relaxed stride, gradually increasing the duration or distance.
Debout à côté d'un mur, coude plié à 90°: Standing next to a wall, elbow bent at 90° against your body, with a folded towel between your wrist and the wall. Press your wrist into the wall without moving your arm. Hold for a few seconds, then relax. Change direction.
Debout à côté d'un step (ou d'une marche: Stand beside a step (or a stair), parallel to it. Pivot your left leg towards the step and place your left foot on it, as if you were facing the step. Push through your left leg while turning your upper body to step up, and stay on your left leg without putting your right foot down, right knee raised. Step down with the same movement, then switch sides.
Debout à côté d'une table, posez une jam: Standing next to a table, place one bent leg on the table: thigh resting on it, knee bent, foot flat in front of you. Your other leg stays straight on the floor. With your hands on the table, slowly lean your upper body towards the bent leg, keeping your back straight, until you feel the stretch at the back of your thigh and in your buttock. Hold, then change legs.
Debout dans l'encadrement d'une porte, a: Standing in a doorway with your forearms against the door frame, lean your body slightly forwards until you feel the stretch across your chest, and hold the position.
Debout de côté par rapport à la poulie o: Standing side-on to the pulley or a resistance band anchored up high, pull the handle diagonally towards the opposite hip while rotating your upper body, then return with control.

Stand side-on to the pulley or band, handle held in front of your chest, straighten your arms in front of you while resisting the rotation of your upper body, then bring your hands back to your chest.
Debout devant un petit obstacle (marche: Stand in front of a small obstacle (low step, box). Lift your knee and step over the obstacle, placing your foot on the other side, then bring your other leg over, without rushing.
Debout face à un mur, avant-bras posés c: Standing facing a wall, forearms against the wall. Slide your forearms upwards as far as you can without pain, keeping your shoulders down, then lower them.
Debout face à un mur, mains au mur, le p: Stand facing a wall, hands on the wall, front foot a hand's width from the wall. Move your knee forwards until it touches the wall without lifting your heel. If this is easy, move your foot back a little. Come back and repeat.
Debout face à un mur, mains posées à pla: Standing facing a wall, hands flat at shoulder height, bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall, then push back until your arms are straight.
Debout face à un mur, une jambe reculée: Standing facing a wall, one leg stepped back and straight, heel on the floor, lean towards the wall until you feel the stretch in your back calf, and hold the position.
Debout ou assis, grandissez-vous, rentre: Standing or sitting, stand tall, tuck your chin in and engage your abdominal muscles to hold an aligned posture.
Debout sur un step (ou une marche basse): Standing on a step (or a low stair), jump forwards and land on both feet, knees bent and well aligned over your feet, without letting them cave inwards. Hold a steady position for two seconds before stepping back up.

Standing on a step (or a low stair), jump forwards and land on one leg, knee slightly bent and aligned over your foot, your other leg bent behind you. Hold your balance for two seconds before stepping back up. Do the set, then change legs.
Debout sur une jambe, faites un petit sa: Standing on one leg, hop forwards a little and land on the same leg, holding the position: knee bent in line with your foot, hips back, upper body leaning slightly forwards. Stay steady before starting again.
Debout sur une jambe, mains sur les hanc: Standing on one leg, hands on your hips, your other foot slightly off the floor. Without moving your standing foot, gently shift your pelvis sideways over your standing leg, then return to the centre. The movement is small and controlled. Do the set, then change legs.
Debout sur une jambe, une sangle ou un g: Standing on one leg, with a strap or a thick resistance band placed behind your knee and anchored in front of you. Sit back by bending your knee, your shin staying vertical, held by the strap. Come back up slowly.
Debout sur une jambe. Pliez le genou, sa: Standing on one leg. Bend your knee, hop forwards and land on the same leg, knee bent and in line with your foot, staying steady before starting again.
Debout sur une jambe. Sautez sur le côté: Standing on one leg. Hop sideways on the same leg, land with your knee bent and in line with your foot and hold the position, then hop to the other side.
Debout sur une marche ou un step, descen: Standing on a stair or a step, slowly lower one leg towards the floor, controlling the bend of your standing knee, without putting your foot down fully, then come back up.
Debout, amenez un bras tendu devant la p: Standing, bring one straight arm across your chest and hold it with your other arm until you feel the stretch in your shoulder, and hold the position.
Debout, avant-pieds sur une surélévation: Standing with the balls of your feet on a raised surface, rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then slowly lower, letting your heels drop below the level of your toes.
Debout, barre au sol devant les tibias,: Standing, with the bar on the floor in front of your shins and your back straight, grip the bar and stand up by pushing through the floor until your hips and knees are fully straight, then lower with control.
Debout, bras levé sur le côté à hauteur: Stand with your arm raised out to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent at 90°, band anchored in front of you. Rotate your forearm upwards until it is vertical, without dropping your elbow, then return slowly.
Debout, bras tendu devant vous. Avec l'a: Standing, arm straight out in front of you. With your other hand, gently pull your fingers towards you, palm facing forwards, then do the same with your palm facing down to stretch the top of your forearm. Hold each position.
Debout, bras tendus sur les côtés, effec: Standing with your arms straight out to the sides, make small circles with your arms, first in one direction and then the other.
Debout, charge dans les mains, jambes pr: Standing, holding the weight in your hands with your legs almost straight, lean your upper body forwards while pushing your hips back, back straight, until you feel the stretch at the back of your thighs, then come back up.
Debout, croisez une jambe derrière l'aut: Standing, cross one leg behind the other. Raise the arm on the same side as your back leg above your head and push your hip out to the side while leaning your upper body to the other side. Hold the position.
Debout, descendez en squat, posez les ma: Standing, squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank position, then immediately bring your feet back towards your hands and stand up.
From standing, drop into a squat, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank position, then bring your feet back towards your hands and stand up, with no jump at the end.

Standing, drop into a squat, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank position, bring your feet back towards your hands, then jump straight up with your arms reaching overhead.
Debout, élastique fixé à hauteur de tail: Standing, with a resistance band anchored at waist height on the same side as the working arm, your elbow bent to 90° and tucked against your body (a rolled-up towel between your elbow and ribs helps). Start with your forearm turned outwards, then bring your hand across in front of your stomach without letting your elbow leave your side. Slowly return.

Standing, with a resistance band anchored at waist height on the side opposite the working arm, your elbow bent to 90° and tucked against your body (a rolled-up towel between your elbow and ribs helps). Start with your forearm across your stomach, then rotate your forearm outwards without letting your elbow leave your side. Slowly return.
Debout, élastique positionné juste au-de: Standing, with a resistance band just above your ankles or knees, move one leg out to the side against the resistance, then return with control.
Debout, élastique tendu devant vous à ha: Standing, with a resistance band held taut in front of you at chest height and your arms straight, pull your hands apart out to the sides while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then slowly return.
Debout, en équilibre sur une jambe, attr: Standing, balancing on one leg, take hold of your other ankle behind you and bring your heel towards your buttock until you feel the stretch at the front of your thigh, and hold the position.
Debout, faites de grands cercles lents a: Standing, make large, slow circles with your shoulders, backwards and then forwards.
Debout, haltères ou corde tenus en prise: Stand holding dumbbells or a rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) by your sides, bend your elbows to raise the weight towards your shoulders, then lower slowly.
Debout, jetez rapidement les mains au so: Standing, quickly drop your hands to the floor and throw your feet back into a low plank position, then bring your feet back towards your hands and stand up.
Debout, les mains en appui sur un dossie: Standing, hands resting on the back of a chair. Bend one knee to bring your heel towards your buttock, keeping your thighs side by side, then lower slowly.
Debout, levez le bras tendu vers l'avant: Standing, raise your straight arm forwards as far as is comfortable, helped by your other hand if needed.
Debout, mains agrippées au cadre d'une p: Standing, holding on to a door frame, lean your upper body back with your arms straight, then pull your chest towards your hands while squeezing your shoulder blades together, before slowly returning.
Debout, mains jointes devant la poitrine: Standing, hands together in front of your chest. Take a big step forwards into a lunge, knees bent at 90°. Keeping the lunge still and controlled, slowly turn your upper body towards your front leg, come back, then step forward with the other leg.
Debout, mains sur les hanches. Levez un: Standing, hands on your hips. Lift one foot and balance on the other leg, knee slightly soft, pelvis level. To progress: knee raised to hip height, eyes closed, or standing on a cushion.
Debout, montez légèrement sur la pointe: Standing, rise up slightly onto your toes and hold the position for a few seconds.
Debout, penchez le buste en avant pour p: From standing, lean your upper body forwards to put your hands on the floor, walk your hands forwards into a plank position, then walk your feet towards your hands and stand up.
Debout, pieds ancrés au sol, faites pivo: Standing, feet firmly planted on the floor, gently rotate your upper body to one side and then the other, keeping your pelvis facing forwards.
Debout, pieds écartés largeur du bassin,: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips. Slowly shift your body weight onto one leg, then onto the other, without lifting your feet.
Debout, pieds écartés. Levez un bras au-: Standing, feet apart. Raise one arm above your head and lean your upper body to the opposite side, without turning your pelvis, until you feel the stretch along your side. Hold the position.
Debout, pieds joints, genoux légèrement: Stand with your feet together, knees slightly bent. Jump to the side keeping your feet together, land with your knees bent and steady, pause, then jump to the other side.
Debout, poids dans chaque main le long d: Standing, with a weight in each hand by your sides, lift your shoulders towards your ears without bending your elbows, hold briefly, then lower with control.
Debout, poids devant les cuisses, levez: Stand with the weights in front of your thighs and raise one or both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower slowly.
Debout, poids tenu devant les cuisses, f: Standing, holding the weight in front of your thighs, bend your elbows to lift the weight towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows still by your sides, then slowly lower.
Debout, sautez en écartant simultanément: From standing, jump while spreading your legs and raising your straight arms above your head at the same time, then jump back to the starting position.
Debout, un bâton tenu dans le dos, en co: Standing, with a stick held along your back, touching your head, upper back and pelvis. Push your hips back while leaning your upper body forwards, keeping your back straight and the stick in contact at all times, then return.
Debout, un haltère dans chaque main au n: Standing, with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, push them upwards until your arms are fully straight above your head, then lower them slowly.
Debout, un haltère dans une main le long: Standing, with a dumbbell in one hand by your side, bend your upper body sideways, letting the dumbbell slide down your leg, then come back up by tightening your obliques.
Debout, un pied devant l'autre, élastiqu: Standing, one foot in front of the other, with a resistance band placed behind your front knee and anchored in front of you at knee height. Start with your knee slightly bent, pulled forwards by the band, then fully straighten your knee by pushing back against the band. Return slowly.
Debout, un poids dans chaque main le lon: Stand with a weight in each hand by your sides, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, then lower slowly.
Debout, un poids tenu à deux mains contr: Stand holding a weight with both hands against your chest, lower yourself by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, back straight, then come back up.
Debout, une charge lourde dans chaque ma: Stand with a heavy weight in each hand, shoulders down and core engaged, and walk with small, steady steps for the planned distance or time.
Debout, une serviette tenue derrière le: Standing, holding a towel behind your back, one hand at the top above your shoulder and the other at the bottom. Gently pull the towel upwards with your top hand to raise your bottom hand up your back.
Dos à la poulie basse, corde entre les j: With your back to the low pulley and the rope between your legs, lean your upper body forwards while pushing your hips back, then stand up by squeezing your glutes until your hips are fully extended.
Dos appuyé contre un mur, descendez jusq: With your back against a wall, lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor, knees at a right angle, and hold the position.
Dos contre un mur, glissez lentement ver: With your back against a wall, slowly slide down by bending your knees slightly, hold, then come back up.
Dos et fesses appuyés contre un mur, les: Back and buttocks against a wall, feet about two foot-lengths in front, legs straight, heels on the floor. Lift your toes as high as you can, hold for one second, then lower them slowly.
Élastique fixé devant vous à hauteur de: With a resistance band anchored in front of you at face height, pull towards your face, spreading your hands apart and squeezing your shoulder blades together, elbows high, then slowly return.
Élastique fixé devant vous, assis ou deb: With a resistance band anchored in front of you, sitting or standing, pull the handles towards your stomach while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then slowly return.
Élastique positionné aux chevilles ou ju: With a resistance band at your ankles or just above your knees and your legs slightly bent, move sideways with small steps, keeping the band under tension.
Élastique positionné aux chevilles, jamb: With a resistance band at your ankles and your legs slightly bent, move forwards with diagonal crossing steps, keeping the band under tension.
Élastique positionné juste au-dessus des: With a resistance band just above your knees or across your shoulders, lower yourself by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, back straight, then come back up.
With a resistance band just above your knees, on all fours, lift your leg out to the side against the resistance, then lower with control.
With a resistance band just above your knees, lie on your side with your knees bent and open your top knee against the resistance, then close it with control.
With a resistance band just above your knees, lie on your back with your knees bent and lift your hips while pushing your knees out against the resistance, then lower with control.
With a resistance band just above your knees, lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and lift your hips while pushing your knees out against the resistance, then lower.
En appui sur des barres parallèles, corp: Supported on parallel bars with your body upright, lower yourself by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are straight.
En appui sur les avant-bras et les genou: Resting on your forearms and knees, keep your back straight and your tummy engaged, and hold.
En appui sur les avant-bras et les point: Resting on your forearms and toes, body in a straight line from ankles to head, hold the position without letting your pelvis sag or rise.
En appui sur les mains et les pieds, gen: Supported on your hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor and your back flat, hold the position, keeping your hips level with your shoulders.
En appui sur les mains et un genou, pous: Supported on your hands and one knee, push your other foot backwards and upwards by squeezing your glute, then return with control.
En appui sur un avant-bras et le bord du: Resting on one forearm and the edge of your foot, body in a straight line from your ankles to your head, hold the position without letting your pelvis sag.
En appui sur un avant-bras, jambe du des: Supported on one forearm, with your top leg resting on a bench and your bottom leg straight, lift your hips and your bottom leg off the floor and hold the position.
En appui sur une jambe, dos droit, pench: Standing on one leg with your back straight, lean your upper body forward while extending your other leg behind you until you feel the stretch at the back of your standing thigh, then come back up with control.
En équilibre sur une jambe devant une ch: Balancing on one leg in front of a chair or low bench, lower yourself by bending your standing knee until you lightly touch the seat, then come back up.
En équilibre sur une jambe, avant-pied s: Balancing on one leg with the ball of your foot on a raised surface, rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly, stretching your calf.
En équilibre sur une jambe, buste penché: Balancing on one leg, upper body leaning forwards, rotate your pelvis from one side to the other while keeping your standing leg stable, arms out to the sides for balance.
En équilibre sur une jambe, l'autre jamb: Balancing on one leg, with the other leg bent behind you without touching the floor, lower yourself by bending your standing knee until your back knee lightly brushes the floor, then come back up.
En équilibre sur une jambe, mains sur le: Balancing on one leg, hands on your hips. Bend your standing knee and reach to touch the floor as far in front of you as you can with the toes of your other foot, without putting weight on it, then return. Repeat backwards, diagonally.
En équilibre sur une jambe, sautez latér: Balancing on one leg, hop sideways onto the other leg, cushioning the landing, with your free leg crossing behind, like a skater.
En fente avant, arrière ou latérale selo: In a forward, backward or side lunge depending on the variation, lower yourself until your knees form a right angle, back straight, then come back up by pushing through your front foot.
En fente avant, posez la main opposée au: In a forward lunge, place your opposite hand on the floor inside your front foot, then rotate your upper body and free arm towards the ceiling, opening up your chest.
En fente basse, genou arrière au sol, po: In a low lunge with your back knee on the floor, push your pelvis slightly forwards until you feel the stretch at the front of the back hip, and hold the position.
En fente basse, un genou au sol, poignée: In a low lunge with one knee on the floor, holding the pulley handle in front of your chest, straighten your arms in front of you while resisting the rotation of your upper body, then bring your hands back to your chest.
En fente fixe, genoux pliés, élastique f: In a static lunge, knees bent, with a band anchored high to the side and held in both hands. Keeping the lunge still and your core braced, pull the band diagonally towards the opposite hip while turning your upper body, then return slowly.
En planche haute, écartez puis resserrez: In a high plank, jump your feet apart and back together with small hops, like a jumping jack, keeping your pelvis stable and braced.
En planche haute, mains sous les épaules: In a high plank, hands under your shoulders, alternately touch the opposite shoulder with each hand without letting your pelvis sway.
En planche latérale sur l'avant-bras, la: In a side plank on your forearm, let your hip lower gently towards the floor, then lift it back up, without letting your pelvis rotate forwards or backwards.
En position assise (machine) ou debout à: Sitting (on a machine) or standing at the pulley, move your leg out to the side against the resistance, then slowly return.
Sitting (on a machine) or standing at the pulley, bring your leg in towards the middle of your body against the resistance, then slowly return.
En position basse de pompe, mains très é: In the low push-up position, hands very wide apart, shift your weight from one side to the other, keeping your chest close to the floor, like the carriage of a typewriter.
En position de planche haute, bras tendu: In a high plank position with your arms straight, let your shoulder blades come together as your chest sinks slightly between your arms, then push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, elbows still straight.
En position de planche haute, mains sous: In a high plank position, hands under your shoulders, quickly bring one knee and then the other towards your chest alternately, pelvis stable, at a brisk pace.
In a high plank position, hands under your shoulders, alternately touch the opposite shoulder with each hand while keeping your pelvis stable, without swaying.
En position de pompe, descendez normalem: In a press-up position, lower yourself as normal, then push up powerfully enough for your hands to briefly leave the floor, cushioning the landing.
En vous tenant à un appui, balancez une: Holding onto a support, swing one straight leg forwards and backwards, then sideways, gradually increasing the range of movement.
En vous tenant à un support stable, desc: Holding on to a stable support, lower yourself slightly by bending your knees, then come back up.
En vous tenant à un support, En équilibr: Holding on to a support, balancing on one leg with the other straight out in front of you, lower yourself by bending the standing knee until your hip goes below your knee, then come back up.

Face à la poulie haute avec une corde, t: Facing the high pulley with a rope, pull towards your face, spreading your hands apart and squeezing your shoulder blades together, elbows high, then return slowly with control.
Face à la poulie haute, coudes fixes le: Facing the high pulley, elbows fixed by your sides, straighten your arms downwards until they are fully extended, then bring them back up slowly.
Face à un mur, à genou : le genou arrièr: Kneel facing a wall: back knee on the floor on a cushion, front foot flat, hands on the wall. Gently move your pelvis and front knee towards the wall, front heel on the floor: you feel the stretch in the front calf and at the front of the back hip. Hold the position while breathing calmly.
Face à un mur, faites grimper les doigts: Facing a wall, walk your fingers up the wall to gain range when raising your arm.
Face à un mur, les mains posées dessus,: Facing a wall with your hands on it, take a big lunge: back leg stretched out far behind you, front knee over your ankle. Gently push your pelvis forwards and downwards, upper body upright, until you feel the stretch at the front of your back hip. Hold the position, then change sides.
Face à une marche ou un step, posez tout: Facing a stair or a step, place your whole foot on it and push to step up, straightening your leg, without helping with your other leg, then step back down with control.
Faites un grand pas en arrière et descen: Take a big step backwards and lower yourself until both knees form a right angle, then push back to the starting position.
Faites un grand pas en avant et descende: Take a big step forwards and lower yourself until both knees form a right angle, then push to bring your feet together at the front and carry on with the other leg.
Take a big step forwards and lower yourself until both knees form a right angle, then push back to the starting position.
Faites un grand pas sur le côté et fléch: Take a big step to the side and bend that knee while keeping the other leg straight, hips low, then push back to the centre.
Faites un pas en arrière et sur le côté: Take a step backwards and to the side, crossing your leg behind the other, lower yourself until your back knee almost touches the floor, then push back to the starting position.
Genoux au sol, mains légèrement plus lar: Knees on the floor, hands slightly wider than your shoulders, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Haut du dos calé contre un banc, genoux: With your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent and feet on the floor, and the weight resting on your hips, push your hips up until they are fully extended, then lower.
Jambes fléchies, hanches basses, déplace: Legs bent, hips low, move sideways with small, quick side steps, without crossing your feet.
L'avant-bras posé sur une table, paume v: Forearm resting on a table, palm facing down, hand over the edge holding a light dumbbell. Tilt your hand towards your thumb and then towards your little finger, without moving your forearm.
Le programme équilibré recommandé pour l: The balanced programme recommended for most patients.
Main ouverte, doigts tendus. Enchaînez l: Hand open, fingers straight. Slowly move through: fingers bent into a hook, closed fist, fingers flat and bent at the base, then a full fist, and return to an open hand.
Main ouverte. Touchez successivement le: Hand open. Touch the tip of each finger in turn with the tip of your thumb, from your index finger to your little finger, forming a circle, then open your hand again.
Mains posées sur le bord d'un banc derri: With your hands on the edge of a bench behind you and your legs straight out in front, bend your elbows to lower your hips towards the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Mains posées sur le bord d'une chaise de: With your hands on the edge of a chair behind you, bend your elbows to lower your hips, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Mains posées sur un support surélevé (ba: With your hands on a raised support (bench, step), body braced and straight, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the support, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Mains rapprochées sous la poitrine, pouc: With your hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond, bend your elbows, keeping them close to your body, to lower yourself, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Mains sous les épaules, corps gainé et a: Hands under your shoulders, body braced and in line from heels to head, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Mains très écartées, descendez en pliant: With your hands placed very wide, lower yourself by bending one arm while keeping the other straight out to the side, then push back up and alternate sides.

Marchez quelques pas sur les talons, poi: Walk a few steps on your heels, toes lifted, then a few steps on tiptoe, heels raised, keeping your upper body upright.
Marchez sur place en balançant les bras,: March on the spot, swinging your arms, at a comfortable pace, to warm up.

Partez assis sur les talons, bras allong: Start sitting back on your heels, arms stretched out in front of you, forehead on the floor (child's pose). Slowly slide your upper body forwards until you are lying flat on your front, then push up on your hands, keeping your hips on the floor, to gently arch your back. Then slowly return to child's pose. Move smoothly from one position to the other, in time with your breathing.
Partez en fente au sol devant un step (o: Start in a lunge on the floor in front of a step (or a stair): right leg in front, foot flat, left leg behind. Come up keeping your right foot planted on the floor, bring your left leg forwards while leaning your upper body slightly forwards, place your left foot on the step and push through it to step up, raising your right knee in front of you. Step down with control, then switch sides.
Pédalez 10 minutes à une cadence réguliè: Cycle for 10 minutes at a steady pace on an exercise bike or a normal bike, adjusting the resistance to what you can tolerate.
Penché en avant, une main en appui sur u: Lean forwards with one hand resting on a table and the other arm hanging completely relaxed. Without tensing your shoulder, make small back-and-forth swings and then small circles by moving your body; the arm follows like a pendulum.
Pied arrière posé sur un banc derrière v: With your back foot resting on a bench behind you, lower yourself by bending your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor, then come back up by pushing through your front foot.
Pied avant posé sur une petite surélévat: With your front foot on a small raised surface, lower yourself by bending your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor, then come back up by pushing through your front foot.
Pieds écartés largeur de hanches, kettle: Feet hip-width apart, holding the kettlebell with both hands, swing it between your legs by bending at the hips, then drive it up to chest height with an explosive extension of the hips.
Pieds largeur d'épaules, descendez en fl: With your feet shoulder-width apart, lower yourself by bending your hips and knees as if sitting down, back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then come back up.
Pieds largeur d'épaules, descendez en po: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower into a squat position, then drive upwards into a jump, cushioning the landing by bending your knees again straight away.
Pieds très écartés, pointes tournées ver: With your feet very wide apart and your toes turned out, holding one dumbbell in both hands between your legs, lower yourself by bending your hips and knees, back straight, then come back up.
Pieds très écartés, transférez le poids: With your feet very wide apart, shift your weight to one side by bending that knee and lowering your hips towards your heel, keeping the other leg straight, then return to the centre and alternate.

Push off and cross over the step: the foot that was on the floor lands on the step first, then the other foot lands on the floor on the other side.
